abort.already_configured: This Hubble instance is already configured

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Sends a notification overlay to the Hubble dashboard.

config_entry_id.name: Hubble instance
config_entry_id.description: The Hubble dashboard to send the notification to.

title.name: Title
title.description: Short heading displayed at the top of the notification.

level.name: Level
level.description: Severity level. Determines card colour and icon.

permanent.name: Permanent
permanent.description: If true, notification stays until dismissed. Mutually exclusive with timer.

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: Seconds until auto-dismiss. Mutually exclusive with permanent.

image.name: Image
image.description: Optional image URL or base64 data URI.

dismiss_notification.name: Dismiss notification
dismiss_notification.description: Dismisses a single active notification by its ID.

config_entry_id.name: Hubble instance
config_entry_id.description: The Hubble dashboard to dismiss the notification on.

notification_id.name: Notification ID
notification_id.description: UUID returned by the send_notification action.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Starts or restarts a Hubble timer widget.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Duration in seconds. Omit for stopwatch mode.

label.name: Label
label.description: Display label for this timer run.

reset_timer.name: Reset timer
reset_timer.description: Resets a Hubble timer to idle.
